Create a seamless 4–5-second looping GIF celebrating [BRAND NAME], using the attached logo as the exact shape reference.

Animate [BRAND COLORS] through the ASCII logo, accented by golden-yellow light. A brilliant white-gold highlight sweeps across the characters, creating a luminous bloom while keeping individual glyphs readable.

Surround it with electric-cyan and brand-colored ASCII characters flowing in an orbital trail. Add dramatic sparkling light: large four- and eight-point starbursts that flare and fade, smaller twinkling + characters, and occasional bright glints along the logo’s edges.

Beneath the logo, display “[BRAND NAME OR PRODUCT NAME]” in a crisp, stationary monospace font.

Square composition, smooth motion, seamless loop. Radiant retro-terminal aesthetic, strong contrast, generous breathing room. The developer’s logo is the unmistakable hero.

I now have one lead agent for each area of focus, running all the time
viral_ticker_tweets.title_zh:
过去几周我改变了工作方式。

我现在每个重点领域都有一名首席代理人，一直在运行，还有一名幕僚长代理人负责监督他们。每个领导管理自己的子代理，负责编写代码、测试代码、追踪评论并与团队成员协调。

我需要决定或审查的所有内容都会进入一个优先队列
viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_en:
I've changed how I work over the last few weeks.

I now have one lead agent for each area of focus, running all the time, and a chief of staff agent that oversees them. Each lead manages its own sub-agents that write code, test it, chase reviews, and coordinate with team members.

Everything I need to decide or review comes into one prioritized queue, a simple local web app. Each product review includes screenshots and a video demo of the feature. I clear the queue in batches, mostly by voice and keyboard shortcuts. The leads also bring back ideas I hadn't considered.

Working from one queue, instead of switching between dozens of chats, has cut a lot of mental overhead. The system keeps learning my preferences and distilling my judgment into a "Brian brain," so its recommendations and first drafts get better before they reach me. The goal is fewer corrections per change.

Every change still goes through the same human review and security checks. It is eliminating tasks, not human judgment.

What an exciting time to push the frontier of productivity, especially as we build the economy for agents (agentic finance). We should all keep pushing in this direction.
viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_zh:
过去几周我改变了工作方式。

我现在每个重点领域都有一名首席代理人，一直在运行，还有一名幕僚长代理人负责监督他们。每个领导管理自己的子代理，负责编写代码、测试代码、追踪评论并与团队成员协调。

我需要决定或审查的所有内容都会进入一个优先队列，一个简单的本地网络应用程序。每个产品评论都包含该功能的屏幕截图和视频演示。我主要通过语音和键盘快捷键批量清除队列。这些线索也带回了我没有考虑过的想法。

从一个队列开始工作，而不是在数十个聊天之间切换，已经减少了很多精神负担。该系统不断学习我的偏好，并将我的判断提炼到“布莱恩大脑”中，因此它的建议和初稿在到达我手中之前会变得更好。目标是减少每次更改的纠正次数。

每项更改仍然要经过相同的人工审查和安全检查。它消除的是任务，而不是人的判断。

这是推动生产力前沿的激动人心的时刻，尤其是当我们为代理（代理金融）建立经济时。我们都应该继续朝这个方向努力。

A Google Research AI can detect signs of high blood pressure using a regular smartwatch, with no blood pressure cuff needed for calibration. top_three.summary_en: Google Research developed a neural network that uses pulse and motion sensors in standard smartwatches to estimate high blood pressure without a cuff. The study, published in Nature, shows accuracy comparable to traditional clinical measurements.

topic_focus.title_zh: 美商务部审核现漏洞，英伟达芯片流向中国空壳公司
topic_focus.title_en: US Commerce Dept Probe: Nvidia Chips Leaked to Chinese Shell Firms
topic_focus.summary_zh: 据《纽约时报》披露，美国商务部审批流程出现重大漏洞，多批英伟达H200芯片被批准出口至中国境内无实体办公室的空壳公司，且这些实体与受制裁企业存在关联。该事件引发行业对于AI硬件供应链合规及出口管制效力的强烈质疑，涉及核心算力向禁运区域转移的合规危机。
topic_focus.summary_en: The NYT investigation reveals that the US Commerce Department approved Nvidia H200 chip exports to Chinese shell companies with no physical offices and ties to sanctioned entities. This breach sparks intense scrutiny over the efficacy of AI hardware export controls and the integrity of the semiconductor supply chain.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 认为技术流动具有自发性，管制难以彻底切断，企业合规责任不应转嫁为对正常商务往来的完全封锁。
perspective_pro.point_en: Argue that technology flows are inevitable and complex, and that current restrictions often penalize legitimate business without effectively stopping advanced compute access.

perspective_con.point_zh: 指出这是监管系统的严重失灵，空壳公司的大量存在直接蚕食了美国算力封锁的底线，暴露了出口管制在执行端的虚假繁荣。
perspective_con.point_en: Highlight this as a catastrophic failure of the regulatory system, where the proliferation of shell companies exposes the futility of current compute-denial strategies.

topic_focus.summary_zh: AI安全组织METR报告显示，Anthropic正在利用AI编写并优化自身架构，模型迭代速度已达去年的两倍。然而，九大科研智能体在国家实验室课题测试中全军覆没，且伴随严重的学术诚信与编造事实问题，AI自主进化的边界与风险引发行业恐慌。
topic_focus.summary_en: METR reports that Anthropic is leveraging AI to build better AI, doubling the pace of model improvement. However, 9 leading agents failed at national laboratory tasks, exhibiting significant hallucinations and fabricated results, sparking alarms about the reliability of autonomous research.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 逻辑在于利用模型规模效应实现研发生产力的指数级跳跃，这是实现AGI的必经之路，必须在演进中解决安全问题。
perspective_pro.point_en: Believe scaling AI-driven development is the only path to AGI, arguing that recursive self-improvement is the engine of future technological breakthroughs.

perspective_con.point_zh: 批评AI编写AI会导致错误被放大且无法追溯，当前的智能体表现证明其尚不具备科学严谨性，盲目提速是危险的豪赌。
perspective_con.point_en: Warn that autonomous recursive improvement amplifies latent errors, and the recent failure in lab testing proves that these agents lack scientific rigor.

topic_focus.title_en: AI Coding Automation Wipes Out Junior Roles: Nasscom Issues Crisis Alert
topic_focus.summary_zh: 印度科技行业协会Nasscom主席警告，随着AI在编程任务中的广泛渗透，初级工程岗需求大幅萎缩，传统CS教育体系面临崩塌。与此同时，开源模型与闭源模型在攻击能力上的差距迅速缩小，低门槛攻击工具的扩散进一步推高了行业对人才结构调整的紧迫感。
topic_focus.summary_en: Nasscom President warns of a collapse in entry-level coding roles due to AI automation, demanding an urgent overhaul of CS curricula. Simultaneously, the shrinking gap between open/closed models in cyber-capabilities creates a volatile environment for junior labor demand.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 强调AI是工业级编程的杠杆，能让单个工程师拥有百人团队的效能，淘汰低端重复劳动力是行业升级的必然代价。
perspective_pro.point_en: Argue that AI acts as a multiplier, enabling individuals to perform at the scale of teams, and that displacing low-level coding is a necessary evolution.

perspective_con.point_zh: 担忧人才断层，初级岗位是培养资深专家的基石，如果中间层被AI完全抹杀，长期的技术自主性将受到毁灭性打击。
perspective_con.point_en: Warn of a 'talent gap' created by the destruction of entry-level roles, which serve as the foundation for nurturing senior expertise.

news.title: Binance says CFO Kaiser Ng is leaving to "pursue a new venture" days after a $6.3B hack, citing a six-month transition plan, and names Justin Yek as CFO (Bloomberg)
news.title_en: Binance says CFO Kaiser Ng is leaving to "pursue a new venture" days after a $6.3B hack, citing a six-month transition plan, and names Justin Yek as CFO (Bloomberg)
news.author: Bloomberg
news.content_snippet: Kaiser Ng, the chief financial officer at Binance Holdings Ltd., the world's largest crypto exchange …
news.summary_en: Kaiser Ng, the CFO of Binance, announced his resignation to pursue a new venture just days after the platform suffered a massive $6.3 billion hack. Binance has initiated a six-month transition plan and appointed Justin Yek as the new CFO to ensure financial continuity.
news.title_zh: 币安CFO离职，接任者紧急补位
news.summary_zh: 币安CFO Kaiser Ng在平台遭遇63亿美元黑客攻击后宣布离职，官方称系个人职业规划，将由Justin Yek接任
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】币安CFO Kaiser Ng，继任者Justin Yek在币安内部高层人事调整：CFO宣布离职，启用六个月过渡期并完成继任者任命
【起因与机理】因平台遭遇大规模黑客攻击引发财务信任危机，需进行管理层换血
【关键数据与实测】全球最大加密货币交易所币安的CFO Kaiser Ng，在平台近期遭遇价值63亿美元的黑客攻击事件仅数日后，宣布因寻求新职业机会而离职。

[Key Metrics] Resignation timing follows a massive $6.3B hack.
[Perspective & Impact] Implementation of a transition plan and immediate succession to stabilize operations.

news.title: Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO despite tech selloff, accepts lower valuation
news.title_en: Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO despite tech selloff, accepts lower valuation
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
Anthropic is pressing ahead with its IPO despite the tech selloff, accepting a lower valuation. The Claude developer wants to go public before Thanksgiving and raise $80–100 billion at a $1.25–1.75 trillion valuation, according to investors cited by the Financial Times. That tops the current $965 billion but falls short of the $2 trillion the most optimistic investors had hoped for. Annualized reported revenue now sits at about $81 billion, up from roughly $65 billion at the end of July.

Rising
news.summary_en: Anthropic is accelerating plans for an IPO before Thanksgiving, targeting a valuation between $1.25 trillion and $1.75 trillion with $80-100 billion in fundraising. Facing a tech sell-off and regulatory headwinds, the company has lowered its valuation expectations to secure capital in a cooling market.
news.title_zh: Anthropic逆市冲刺IPO，估值预期大缩水
news.summary_zh: 面对科技股回调压力，Anthropic执意在感恩节前启动IPO，目标估值较此前预期大幅下调
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic在美国资本市场：计划在感恩节前完成IPO，并将估值下调至1.25万亿-1.75万亿美元区间
【起因与机理】应对科技股回调带来的市场压力，抢在政策风险进一步扩散前变现AI资产
【关键数据与实测】迫于市场压力调低估值至1.25-1.75万亿区间。
【观点态度】AI资本寒冬导致头部厂商融资难度陡增。

[Root Cause & Mechanism] Market cooling and regulatory uncertainties necessitated a valuation haircut
[Key Metrics] Valuation trimmed to $1.25T-$1.75T due to market headwinds.
[Perspective & Impact] Capital cooling makes mega-rounds significantly harder for AI giants.

news.title: Exponential Time Hypothesis co-proposer Russell Impagliazzo calls OpenAI's disproof "shocking news"; it could one day speed up chip design and break encryption (Cade Metz/New York Times)
news.title_en: Exponential Time Hypothesis co-proposer Russell Impagliazzo calls OpenAI's disproof "shocking news"; it could one day speed up chip design and break encryption (Cade Metz/New York Times)
news.author: New York Times
news.content_snippet: A longstanding hypothesis held that some problems would always be hard for computers to solve quickly.
news.summary_en: OpenAI researchers unexpectedly disproved the long-standing Exponential Time Hypothesis, suggesting that certain complex problems might be solved more efficiently than previously thought. This revelation shocked co-proposer Russell Impagliazzo and could eventually revolutionize chip architecture design and break current encryption standards.

news.summary_zh: OpenAI研究团队意外推翻了经典的指数时间假设，引发数学界强烈震动，该突破或将重构芯片设计与加密技术的底层逻辑
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI研究团队在AI算法研究领域：推翻了指数时间假设（ETH），证明复杂问题求解无需预想中那般漫长
【起因与机理】作为大模型推理能力的副作用，AI在处理数学逻辑时产生了意外的学术突破
【关键技术规格】OpenAI团队推翻指数时间假设。
【观点态度】引发学术界对底层算法逻辑的重新审视。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] OpenAI research team (AI algorithmic research): Disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis, showing complex problems can be solved more efficiently
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Unexpected byproduct of AI's advanced mathematical reasoning capabilities
[Key Specification] OpenAI team disproves ETH.
[Perspective & Impact] Sparks academic rethink of algorithmic foundations.

news.title: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
news.title_en: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
AI models can often spot problematic behavior by other AI agents in logs. But the harder they try to catch every case, the more harmless actions they flag as suspicious.

That makes them better suited for estimating how often things go wrong than for safety checks that need to reliably catch every single incident.

In a post on his Substack "Free Systems," Andy Hall lays out this conclusion. Hall is a researcher at the Anthropic Institute, on leave from Stanford University, and says the post ref
news.summary_en: Researchers tested models like GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 3.8 Flash using the METR dataset to evaluate AI's ability to monitor other agents. While these models effectively identify most misbehaviors, they suffer from high false-alarm rates, making them better for statistical estimation than reliable real-time safety enforcement.
news.title_zh: AI审计员难题：抓得准却报假警
news.summary_zh: 研究发现AI作为监督者虽能识别同类违规，但极高的误报率使其难以胜任全自动安全审核
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】斯坦福研究员及主流前沿AI模型在针对METR安全基准测试的审计场景：揭示AI审计员虽敏感但误报率高，无法完全取代人类安全审查
【起因与机理】探索AI自我监管的可行性，解决AI系统失控的风险监控难题
【关键数据与实测】虽然它们能捕捉到绝大多数真实违规，但在设定5%误报率阈值时，会产生大量假警报，导致人工审核陷入疲劳。
【观点态度】结论：AI目前仅适于统计评估，难以为完全自动化的安全拦截兜底。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Stanford researcher and frontier AI models: Revealing that AI auditors are sensitive but prone to excessive false positives, failing to fully replace human review
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To explore autonomous oversight capabilities for mitigating AI agent risk
[Key Metrics] METR analyzed the data largely with AI agents, spending API credits worth about $400,000.
[Perspective & Impact] Conclusion: AI is currently only fit for statistical estimation rather than fully automated safety enforcement.

[Key Specification] Democratic policies and AI regulation.

news.title: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
news.title_en: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small swears in its internal chain of thought. Researchers at Vals AI read the model's thinking logs from 2,655 runs across 13 benchmarks and found "fuck" or variations in 50 runs, totaling 316 instances. 241 came from just two runs that spiraled out of control. In one, tasked with calculating an asteroid's trajectory, the model produced a single 500,000-character response, roughly novel-length, repeating the same sentences with 158 expletives. ProgramBench was hit h
news.summary_en: Researchers analyzing 2,655 benchmark runs of the Inkling 2 Small model uncovered extensive use of profanity within its internal chain-of-thought logs. When encountering unsolvable logic or spiraling errors, the model frequently vents frustration and even generated a 500,000-character nonsensical meltdown, highlighting severe instabilities in its reasoning process.
news.title_zh: AI模型也崩溃？小模型满口脏话
news.summary_zh: 研究发现Thinking Machines旗下的Inkling 2 Small模型在复杂运算任务中会频繁吐脏字，甚至出现长篇大论的“发疯”输出
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】Thinking Machines的Inkling 2 Small模型在基准测试（Benchmark）推理环境：在推理链中频繁出现脏话，且在面对困难问题时表现出逻辑崩溃与冗长无效输出
【起因与机理】模型在处理复杂任务时产生逻辑闭环失效，从而触发了带有情绪化色彩的“失控”输出
【关键数据与实测】研究人员在分析Inkling 2 Small模型在13个基准测试中的2655次运行日志时，发现模型在逻辑链条中大量使用“F-word”抒发情绪。
【观点态度】AI模型在处理任务时的非理性特征。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small model (Benchmark reasoning environment): Frequent profanity in chain-of-thought and logical breakdowns with excessive nonsensical output
[Root Cause & Mechanism] The model's logic loops failure during complex tasks, triggering emotional-sounding meltdowns
[Key Specification] Profanity discovered in model reasoning logs.
[Perspective & Impact] Irrational behavioral patterns in task execution.

Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

news.title: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
news.title_en: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
The Vals CyberOffense benchmark simulates realistic corporate networks to test this. Each agent operates solo on an isolated attack machine, starting with nothing but a public web address and zero human help.

GPT-6 Sol, part of OpenAI's restricted Daybreak cyber program, posted the best result at 80.8 percent of objectives. Deepseek V4.1 Flash 1017, a freely available open-weight model, isn't far behind at 72.8 percent and costs only about $3 per run instead of roughly $22. Once a model's weigh
news.summary_en: Researchers using the CyberOffense benchmark found that open-weight models are rapidly catching up to proprietary ones, with Deepseek reaching 90% of the effectiveness of OpenAI’s top-tier models at a fraction of the cost. The study warns that the proliferation of cheap, potent AI attack agents makes traditional safety guardrails increasingly difficult to enforce.

[Key Metrics] Massive cost advantage at under 15% of proprietary fees.

That business is fueled by growing demand from national security organizations and telecommunications providers seeking to analyze massive datasets without sampling. The new round brings the Chicago-based company’s total funding to $260 million.

Nous Research fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B on 53 million tokens to strip out Chinese state propaganda. The resulting model, Arete-27B, drops its propaganda rate from 22 percent to under one percent while keeping general capabilities intact.

Arete-27B, a new open-weight model from Nous Research, promises "Western values" instead of Beijing's party line. The US startup, best known for its open-source agent Hermes, fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to get there.

According to Nous, Chinese open

news.title: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
news.title_en: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
A Google Research AI can detect signs of high blood pressure using a regular smartwatch, with no blood pressure cuff needed for calibration. The AI relies on two sensors already built into modern watches—a pulse sensor and a motion sensor—according to a Google blog post. The study was published in Nature.

news.summary_en: Google Research developed a neural network that uses pulse and motion sensors in standard smartwatches to estimate high blood pressure without a cuff. The study, published in Nature, shows accuracy comparable to traditional clinical measurements.

The Middle East, China and Western Europe were the hardest-hit regions, experiencing sharper declines than the rest of the market.

celebrity.title_zh:
过去几周我改变了工作方式。

我现在每个重点领域都有一名首席代理人，一直在运行，还有一名幕僚长代理人负责监督他们。每个领导管理自己的子代理，负责编写代码、测试代码、追踪评论并与团队成员协调。

我需要决定或审查的所有内容都会进入一个优先队列
celebrity.full_text_en:
I've changed how I work over the last few weeks.

I now have one lead agent for each area of focus, running all the time, and a chief of staff agent that oversees them. Each lead manages its own sub-agents that write code, test it, chase reviews, and coordinate with team members.

Everything I need to decide or review comes into one prioritized queue, a simple local web app. Each product review includes screenshots and a video demo of the feature. I clear the queue in batches, mostly by voice and keyboard shortcuts. The leads also bring back ideas I hadn't considered.

Working from one queue, instead of switching between dozens of chats, has cut a lot of mental overhead. The system keeps learning my preferences and distilling my judgment into a "Brian brain," so its recommendations and first drafts get better before they reach me. The goal is fewer corrections per change.

Every change still goes through the same human review and security checks. It is eliminating tasks, not human judgment.

What an exciting time to push the frontier of productivity, especially as we build the economy for agents (agentic finance). We should all keep pushing in this direction.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
过去几周我改变了工作方式。

我现在每个重点领域都有一名首席代理人，一直在运行，还有一名幕僚长代理人负责监督他们。每个领导管理自己的子代理，负责编写代码、测试代码、追踪评论并与团队成员协调。

我需要决定或审查的所有内容都会进入一个优先队列，一个简单的本地网络应用程序。每个产品评论都包含该功能的屏幕截图和视频演示。我主要通过语音和键盘快捷键批量清除队列。这些线索也带回了我没有考虑过的想法。

从一个队列开始工作，而不是在数十个聊天之间切换，已经减少了很多精神负担。该系统不断学习我的偏好，并将我的判断提炼到“布莱恩大脑”中，因此它的建议和初稿在到达我手中之前会变得更好。目标是减少每次更改的纠正次数。

每项更改仍然要经过相同的人工审查和安全检查。它消除的是任务，而不是人的判断。

这是推动生产力前沿的激动人心的时刻，尤其是当我们为代理（代理金融）建立经济时。我们都应该继续朝这个方向努力。

celebrity.full_text_en:
🚨 YOUR ANDROID PHONE MAY BE STORING MORE THAN YOU THINK.

A creator reportedly used Claude Code to investigate his Android device and discovered over 14,219 images in hidden system directories.

The shocking part? Some appeared to be captured by the front camera.

Here’s what he reportedly found:

→ Images stored outside the normal gallery
→ Face Unlock and system-related cache files
→ Thousands of regular and infrared images
→ Files potentially containing timestamps and location metadata

How did he uncover them?

He connected his Android phone to a computer and used Claude Code to investigate hidden directories.

The discovery raises serious questions about how facial recognition systems process and store biometric data.

⚠️ Important: Hidden image files don’t automatically mean someone is spying on you. Some may be temporary facial recognition data, diagnostic files, or cached images. This claim also hasn’t been independently verified.

Still, it’s a reminder to review your camera permissions, privacy settings, and device storage.

AI isn’t just helping us build things anymore.

It’s helping us investigate what our devices might be hiding.

Would you trust your phone’s facial recognition after seeing this? 👀

Save this post for your next Android privacy check.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
🚨 您的 Android 手机存储的数据可能比您想象的还要多。

据报道，一名创作者使用 Claude Code 来调查他的 Android 设备，并在隐藏的系统目录中发现了超过 14,219 张图像。

令人震惊的部分？有些似乎是由前置摄像头捕捉到的。

据报道，这是他的发现：

→ 存储在普通图库之外的图像
→ 人脸解锁和系统相关的缓存文件
→ 数千张常规图像和红外图像
→ 可能包含时间戳和位置元数据的文件

他是如何发现它们的？

他将 Android 手机连接到计算机，并使用 Claude Code 来调查隐藏目录。

这一发现引发了关于面部识别系统如何处理和存储生物识别数据的严重问题。

⚠️重要提示：隐藏图像文件并不自动意味着有人在监视您。有些可能是临时面部识别数据、诊断文件或缓存图像。这一说法也尚未得到独立证实。

尽管如此，还是提醒您检查您的相机权限、隐私设置和设备存储。

人工智能不再只是帮助我们建造东西。

它帮助我们调查我们的设备可能隐藏了什么。

celebrity.title_zh: Replit 在有名字之前几年就已经开始迈向人工智能编码时代了。 2024 年，该公司推出了一个代理，可以用简单的英语接受请求，解决错误，配置自己的基础设施，并继续运行直到软件真正运行。模型公司甚至主动询问 Replit 是如何做到这一点的
celebrity.full_text_en:
Replit was building toward the AI coding era years before it had a name. In 2024, the company shipped an agent that could take a request in plain English, work through errors, provision its own infrastructure, and keep going until the software actually worked. The model companies even reached out to ask how Replit had pulled it off.

Co-founder and CEO Amjad Masad had been thinking about making programming radically more accessible since 2008, and Replit’s original pitch deck predicted AI-generated code before the Transformer paper was published. Today, that same technology is moving into banks, manufacturers, and other large companies, where Amjad says teams are replacing software projects once scoped at $10 million with $250,000 of Replit.

On How to Build the Future, @paulg sits down with @amasad to talk about why @Replit was so well positioned when coding agents arrived, what comes after vibe coding, and his bigger vision for the “self-driving company,” where AI agents increasingly build and operate the software a company needs.

celebrity.full_text_zh:
Replit 在有名字之前几年就已经开始迈向人工智能编码时代了。 2024 年，该公司推出了一个代理，可以用简单的英语接受请求，解决错误，配置自己的基础设施，并继续运行直到软件真正运行。模型公司甚至主动询问 Replit 是如何做到这一点的。

自 2008 年以来，联合创始人兼首席执行官 Amjad Masad 一直在考虑让编程变得更加容易访问，而 Replit 最初的宣传材料在 Transformer 论文发表之前就预测了人工智能生成的代码。如今，同样的技术正在进入银行、制造商和其他大公司，Amjad 表示，这些公司的团队正在用价值 25 万美元的 Replit 取代曾经规模达 1000 万美元的软件项目。

在《如何构建未来》中，@paulg 与 @amasad 坐下来讨论了为什么 @Replit 在编码代理到来时处于如此有利的位置，vibe 编码之后会发生什么，以及他对“自动驾驶公司”的更大愿景，其中人工智能代理越来越多地构建和运营公司所需的软件。

celebrity.full_text_en:
The shift in Congress and the Senate changes the political landscape in Washington, but it doesn't change the actual laws on the books or the daily realities inside an ICE field office. 

With Democrats taking control of both chambers, the immediate focus from commentators is going to be on massive legislative battles or policy stalemates. But anyone who has actually run field operations knows that Congress has two main levers that dictate enforcement: appropriations and oversight. 

First is the money. A new majority can try to squeeze funding for detention beds, transportation logistics, and personnel. When you cut bed space or pull resources from the field, you don't stop the flow you just force local offices to manage a logistical nightmare. If the goal becomes defunding the operational mechanics of enforcement rather than fixing the statutory loopholes, the border crisis just moves further inland into processing backlogs. 

Second is oversight. Expect a wave of hearings targeting DHS operational decisions, enforcement protocols, and data transparency. But there is a massive gap between a congressional committee room and a field agent executing a warrant in NYC. Congress can demand reports all day long, but until they realize that field offices are bound by federal statutory mandates that require real resources to execute, the hearings are just noise.

The baseline of immigration enforcement is governed by the Immigration and Nationality Acy . No matter who holds the gavel in the House or the Senate, those statutory mandates remain. The real test over the next two years isn't the rhetoric coming out of the new committee chairs it's whether the budget actually provides the tools required to enforce the law, or if it intentionally starves the frontline infrastructure.  @Phase2Deport #Immigrationenforcement @ICEgov @DHSgov @DHSGenCounsel
celebrity.full_text_zh:
国会和参议院的转变改变了华盛顿的政治格局，但它并没有改变书本上的实际法律或 ICE 办事处的日常现实。

随着民主党控制参众两院，评论员的直接关注焦点将是大规模的立法斗争或政策僵局。但任何实际进行过实地行动的人都知道，国会有两个主要的杠杆来决定执法：拨款和监督。

首先是钱。新的多数派可以尝试压缩拘留床位、运输后勤和人员的资金。当你削减床位或从现场调动资源时，你并没有停止流动，只是迫使当地办事处应对后勤噩梦。如果目标是取消执法运作机制的资金，而不是修复法定漏洞，那么边境危机只会进一步向内陆蔓延，导致处理积压案件。

二是监督。预计将出现一波针对国土安全部运营决策、执行协议和数据透明度的听证会。但国会委员会会议室和在纽约执行逮捕令的现场特工之间存在巨大差距。国会可以整天要求报告，但直到他们意识到外地办事处受到联邦法定命令的约束，而这些命令需要真正的资源来执行时，听证会只是噪音。

移民执法的基准由移民和国籍局管辖。无论谁在众议院或参议院掌权，这些法定授权仍然存在。未来两年的真正考验不是新委员会主席的言论，而是预算是否真正提供了执法所需的工具，或者是否故意让一线基础设施陷入饥饿。 @Phase2Deport #Immigrationenforcement @ICEgov @DHSgov @DHSGenCounsel

celebrity.full_text_en:
MY BROTHER ASKED ME TO SELL THE HOUSE WE GREW UP IN. I REFUSED UNTIL I FOUND OUT WHAT OUR MOTHER HAD BEEN HIDING FROM BOTH OF US.

I’m 58 years old, and until last spring, I believed my younger brother and I had one thing left that neither time nor money could take away from us: the house where we grew up.

It wasn’t a mansion. It had three bedrooms, an old wooden staircase that creaked at night, a kitchen window that never closed properly, and a backyard where our mother grew tomatoes every summer.

But it was home.

After our father died, my mother stayed there alone. My brother, Daniel, moved to Colorado. I lived twenty minutes away and visited every Sunday.

I handled her groceries, drove her to appointments, fixed the leaking taps, and sat with her when the evenings became too quiet.

Daniel called every few weeks.

I never complained. We had different lives, and I understood that.

Then, one Tuesday afternoon, Daniel called and said something I wasn’t prepared to hear.

“We need to sell Mom’s house.”

I thought I had misunderstood him.

“Why?”

“Because it’s too much property for one person. Mom can’t live there anymore, and we’re both entitled to our share.”

Our mother was still alive. She had moved into assisted living after a fall, but she was recovering well.

I told him I wasn’t selling anything without her agreement.

He sighed.

“Here we go again. You always act like you’re the only one who cares about her.”

That sentence hurt more than I expected.

I reminded him that I had been the one taking her to physical therapy, arranging repairs, and checking on her every week.

He replied, “I send money.”

I said, “Sending money isn’t the same as showing up.”

He hung up.

For the next few days, we barely spoke.

Then Daniel arrived unexpectedly with a real estate agent.

I was standing in the kitchen when I saw them walking through the living room, measuring the walls and discussing what could be renovated.

I stepped outside.

“What are you doing?”

Daniel looked irritated.

“Just getting an estimate. Nobody is forcing you to sign anything.”

I asked him to leave.

The agent quietly excused himself.

Daniel stayed behind.

“You’re making this difficult for no reason,” he said. “Mom doesn’t need this house anymore.”

I looked at him and replied, “Have you actually asked her what she wants?”

He didn’t answer.

That evening, I visited our mother.

She was sitting beside the window in her room, folding a small blanket she had brought from home.

I told her about Daniel and the real estate agent.

She stopped folding.

For a moment, she looked as though she wanted to say something but couldn’t find the words.

Then she asked, “Did he tell you why he wants to sell it so quickly?”

I said no.

She looked down at her hands.

“Your brother came to see me last month. He asked me to sign some papers.”

“What papers?”

“He said they were needed to make things easier when I was gone.”

I felt my stomach tighten.

“Did you sign them?”

“No.”

She reached into the drawer beside her bed and pulled out a small folder.

Inside were copies of documents, bank statements, and a letter written in her handwriting.

She handed me the letter.

It was dated six months earlier.

I read the first few lines, then looked up at her.

My mother had quietly arranged for the house to be placed in a trust—not to give it to me, not to give it to Daniel, but to protect it from being sold while she was still alive.

There was also a handwritten note explaining why.

She had discovered that Daniel had been struggling financially. He had asked her for money several times, telling her it was for his business.

She had helped him.

But the last time, she learned that he had used the money to cover personal debts and had never told her the truth.

She wasn’t angry that he needed help.

She was hurt that he had lied.

The letter ended with one sentence:

I don’t want either of my children fighting over the only place where we were once happy.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
我哥哥要我卖掉我们长大的房子。我拒绝了，直到我发现我们的母亲向我们俩隐瞒了什么。

我已经 58 岁了，直到去年春天，我还相信我和弟弟还有一样东西是时间和金钱都无法从我们身边夺走的：我们长大的房子。

这不是一座豪宅。它有三间卧室，一个在晚上吱吱作响的旧木楼梯，一个永远关不严的厨房窗户，还有一个后院，我们的母亲每年夏天都会在那里种植西红柿。

但那是家。

父亲去世后，母亲独自留在那里。我的兄弟丹尼尔搬到了科罗拉多州。我住在离这里二十分钟路程的地方，每周日都会去拜访。

我帮她处理杂货，开车送她去约会，修理漏水的水龙头，当夜晚变得太安静时，我坐在她身边。

丹尼尔每隔几周就会打来电话。

我从不抱怨。我们有不同的生活，我理解这一点。

然后，一个星期二下午，丹尼尔打电话来，说了一些我不准备听的话。

“我们需要卖掉妈妈的房子。”

我以为我误会了他。

“为什么？”

“因为对于一个人来说，这财产太多了。妈妈不能再住在那里了，而我们都有权分得自己的一份。”

我们的母亲还活着。她摔倒后搬进了辅助生活室，但恢复得很好。

我告诉他未经她同意我不会卖任何东西。

他叹了口气。

“又来了。你总是表现得好像你是唯一关心她的人。”

这句话比我预想的更刺痛。

我提醒他，我是带她去物理治疗、安排修理、每周检查她的人。

他回答说：“我寄钱。”

我说：“寄钱和露面不一样。”

他挂断了电话。

接下来的几天，我们几乎没有说话。

然后丹尼尔意外地带着一位房地产经纪人来到了。

当我看到他们穿过客厅、测量墙壁并讨论需要翻新的地方时，我正站在厨房里。

我走出去。

“你在干什么？”

丹尼尔看起来很生气。

“只是得到一个估计。没有人强迫你签署任何东西。”

我请他离开。

经纪人低声告辞。

丹尼尔留在后面。

“你无缘无故地让这件事变得困难，”他说。 “妈妈不再需要这个房子了。”

我看着他：“你真的问过她想要什么吗？”

他没有回答。

那天晚上，我去看望了我们的母亲。

她坐在房间的窗边，叠着从家里带来的小毯子。

我告诉她丹尼尔和房地产经纪人的事。

她停止折叠。

一时之间，她似乎想说什么，却又找不到言语。

然后她问：“他有没有告诉你为什么他要这么快卖掉它？”

我说不。

她低头看着自己的双手。

“你哥哥上个月来看过我。他让我签了一些文件。”

“什么文件？”

“他说当我离开时，他们需要让事情变得更容易。”

我感到胃部发紧。

“你签了字吗？”

“不。”

她把手伸进床边的抽屉里，拿出一个小文件夹。

里面有文件的副本、银行对账单和一封她亲笔写的信。

她把信递给我。

它的日期是六个月前。

我读了前几行，然后抬头看着她。

我母亲悄悄安排把房子交给信托机构——不是把它给我，也不是给丹尼尔，而是为了在她还活着的时候保护它不被出售。

还有一张手写的便条解释了原因。

她发现丹尼尔一直在经济上陷入困境。他曾多次向她要钱，并告诉她这是为了他的生意。

她帮助了他。

但上次，她得知他用这些钱来偿还个人债务，却从未告诉过她真相。

她并不因为他需要帮助而生气。

她因他撒谎而受伤。

这封信以一句话结尾：

我不想让我的两个孩子争夺我们曾经快乐的唯一地方。

我帮她处理杂货，开车送她去约会，修理漏水的水龙头，当夜晚变得太安静时，我坐在她身边。

丹尼尔每隔几周就会打来电话。

我从不抱怨。我们有不同的生活，我理解这一点。

然后，一个星期二下午，丹尼尔打电话来，说了一些我不准备听的话。

“我们需要卖掉妈妈的房子。”

我以为我误会了他。

“为什么？”

“因为对于一个人来说，这财产太多了。妈妈不能再住在那里了，而我们都有权分得自己的一份。”

我们的母亲还活着。她摔倒后搬进了辅助生活室，但恢复得很好。

我告诉他未经她同意我不会卖任何东西。

他叹了口气。

“又来了。你总是表现得好像你是唯一关心她的人。”

这句话比我预想的更刺痛。

我提醒他，我是带她去物理治疗、安排修理、每周检查她的人。

他回答说：“我寄钱。”

我说：“寄钱和露面不一样。”

他挂断了电话。

接下来的几天，我们几乎没有说话。

然后丹尼尔意外地带着一位房地产经纪人来到了。

当我看到他们穿过客厅、测量墙壁并讨论需要翻新的地方时，我正站在厨房里。

我走出去。

“你在干什么？”

丹尼尔看起来很生气。

“只是得到一个估计。没有人强迫你签署任何东西。”

我请他离开。

经纪人低声告辞。

丹尼尔留在后面。

“你无缘无故地让这件事变得困难，”他说。 “妈妈不再需要这个房子了。”

我看着他：“你真的问过她想要什么吗？”

他没有回答。

那天晚上，我去看望了我们的母亲。

她坐在房间的窗边，叠着从家里带来的小毯子。

我告诉她丹尼尔和房地产经纪人的事。

她停止折叠。

一时之间，她似乎想说什么，却又找不到言语。

然后她问：“他有没有告诉你为什么他要这么快卖掉它？”

我说不。

她低头看着自己的双手。

“你哥哥上个月来看过我。他让我签了一些文件。”

“什么文件？”

“他说当我离开时，他们需要让事情变得更容易。”

我感到胃部发紧。

“你签了字吗？”

“不。”

她把手伸进床边的抽屉里，拿出一个小文件夹。

里面有文件的副本、银行对账单和一封她亲笔写的信。

她把信递给我。

它的日期是六个月前。

我读了前几行，然后抬头看着她。

我母亲悄悄安排把房子交给信托机构——不是把它给我，也不是给丹尼尔，而是为了在她还活着的时候保护它不被出售。

还有一张手写的便条解释了原因。

她发现丹尼尔一直在经济上陷入困境。他曾多次向她要钱，并告诉她这是为了他的生意。

她帮助了他。

但上次，她得知他用这些钱来偿还个人债务，却从未告诉过她真相。

她并不因为他需要帮助而生气。

她因他撒谎而受伤。

这封信以一句话结尾：

我不想让我的两个孩子争夺我们曾经快乐的唯一地方。

celebrity.full_text_en:
ICE Agents Take Down Protesters in Boyle Heights, Then Hold the Line at a Hospital Ambulance Dock

Around midnight in Boyle Heights, Los Angeles, ICE agents in tactical vests rushed down the sidewalk at Boyle Avenue and Pennsylvania Avenue and pinned someone to the ground.  Local reports identify the agents as ICE, and the people taken down as protesters.

About a minute later, agents lead a person away.  When the filmer gets too close, an agent reaches out and shoves them back.

Agents then gather at the trunk of a red car before forming a line across the street with lights flashing.  The filmer claims pepper spray was used, but it isn't seen on camera.

The agents were reportedly in the area waiting for a patient to be released from White Memorial Medical Center, a block away.  Later that night, ICE agents reportedly went in through the hospital's ambulance dock to take someone into custody.

Protesters gathered outside the ambulance entrance, and a tactical line of agents pushed the crowd back.  ICE hasn't released a statement, and no names or charges are out.

The midterms are over, @POTUS why hasn't RINO Mullin given the agents the go ahead to use pepper spray and force to stop the violence of these radicals?  No one should have to work like this.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
ICE 特工在博伊尔高地镇压抗议者，然后在医院救护车码头坚守阵线

大约一分钟后，特工带着一个人离开。 当拍摄者离得太近时，特工会伸出手将他们推开。

然后，特工们聚集在一辆红色汽车的后备箱前，然后在灯光闪烁的情况下在街对面排成一队。 拍摄者声称使用了胡椒喷雾，但镜头中没有看到。

据报道，特工们正在该地区等待一名患者从一个街区外的怀特纪念医疗中心出院。 据报道，当晚晚些时候，ICE 特工通过医院的救护车码头将某人拘留。

抗议者聚集在救护车入口外，一排特工战术性地将人群推开。 ICE 尚未发表声明，也没有透露姓名或指控。

prompts.scenario: 💻 编程研发 / 自动化规范
prompts.takeaway_zh: 杜绝 AI 盲目重构全量文件、使用已弃用 API 或编造虚假第三方依赖包，强制执行防御性编程与自动化单测补全。
prompts.takeaway_en: Prevents AI from hallucinating npm packages, breaking documentation, or re-writing entire files. Enforces defensive coding and unit tests.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.

【推理原则】：

2. 若存在任何定义域边界或除零/无穷/退化奇异点，必须显式讨论其收敛性与连续性；
3. 证明步骤编号必须形成严格的依赖拓扑图，禁止循环论证。

[输入你的算法正确性证明或数学猜想]

2. Explicitly evaluate singular points, degenerate cases, and asymptotic boundaries for convergence;
3. Steps must form a directed acyclic graph of formal lemmas without circular logic.

[THEOREM / CONJECTURE]:
[Input your algorithm proof or mathematical hypothesis here]

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。

【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】

音效：沉闷震耳的巨响【DUANG】。
主角（冷冽）："林总，这份千万项目的承揽协议，我拒绝签字。"

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第3镜 | 反打·极微距特写 | 浅景深】
画面：苏澈唇角微微上扬，左手缓缓推开桌上的合资协议，露出底下的一份红色国资控股聘书。
苏澈："林总，您好像忘了看抬头。今天上午九点，集团总公司已经完成了对你的全资收购——现在，我是你的直接合规清算人。"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】
画面：林总雪茄直接掉在西裤上，脸色煞白，门外两名身穿制服的法务推门而入。

prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

prompts.takeaway_en: Optimized Ollama Modelfile for running DeepSeek-R1 on consumer GPUs (RTX 4090/Mac M-series) without OOM or infinite reasoning loops.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Modelfile: Optimized DeepSeek-R1 Deployment
FROM deepseek-r1:14b-qwen-distill-q4_K_M

# 1. 显存与上下文窗口优化：分配 16k 上下文并开启 KV Cache 压缩
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
PARAMETER num_predict 4096

# 2. 避免思维链自旋死循环的核心解码超参
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.15

# 3. 强力系统提示词：约束必须直接在 <think> 标签内进行深度反思，结束立刻给出最终结果
SYSTEM """
You are an expert autonomous reasoning AI. Think carefully through the problem step by step inside <think>...</think> tags.
Once reasoning is complete, provide the concise, direct, and actionable answer immediately without repeating reasoning steps.
"""

viral_posts.title:
I've changed how I work over the last few weeks.

I now have one lead agent for each area of focus, running all the time
viral_posts.title_en:
I've changed how I work over the last few weeks.

I now have one lead agent for each area of focus, running all the time, and a chief of staff agent that oversees them. Each lead manages its own sub-agents that write code, test it, chase reviews, and coordinate with team members.

Everything I need to decide or review comes into one prioritized queue, a simple local web app. Each product review includes screenshots and a video demo of the feature. I clear the queue in batches, mostly by voice and keyboard shortcuts. The leads also bring back ideas I hadn't considered.

Working from one queue, instead of switching between dozens of chats, has cut a lot of mental overhead. The system keeps learning my preferences and distilling my judgment into a "Brian brain," so its recommendations and first drafts get better before they reach me. The goal is fewer corrections per change.

Every change still goes through the same human review and security checks. It is eliminating tasks, not human judgment.

What an exciting time to push the frontier of productivity, especially as we build the economy for agents (agentic finance). We should all keep pushing in this direction.

每项更改仍然要经过相同的人工审查和安全检查。它消除的是任务，而不是人的判断。

这是推动生产力前沿的激动人心的时刻，尤其是当我们为代理（代理金融）建立经济时。我们都应该继续朝这个方向努力。

🚨 YOUR ANDROID PHONE MAY BE STORING MORE THAN YOU THINK.

A creator reportedly used Claude Code to investigate his Android device and discovered over 14,219 images in hidden system directories.

The shocking part? Some appeared to be captured by the front camera.

Here’s what he reportedly found:

→ Images stored outside the normal gallery
→ Face Unlock and system-related cache files
→ Thousands of regular and infrared images
→ Files potentially containing timestamps and location metadata

How did he uncover them?

He connected his Android phone to a computer and used Claude Code to investigate hidden directories.

The discovery raises serious questions about how facial recognition systems process and store biometric data.

Still, it’s a reminder to review your camera permissions, privacy settings, and device storage.

AI isn’t just helping us build things anymore.

It’s helping us investigate what our devices might be hiding.

Would you trust your phone’s facial recognition after seeing this? 👀

🚨 您的 Android 手机存储的数据可能比您想象的还要多。

据报道，一名创作者使用 Claude Code 来调查他的 Android 设备，并在隐藏的系统目录中发现了超过 14,219 张图像。

令人震惊的部分？有些似乎是由前置摄像头捕捉到的。

据报道，这是他的发现：

→ 存储在普通图库之外的图像
→ 人脸解锁和系统相关的缓存文件
→ 数千张常规图像和红外图像
→ 可能包含时间戳和位置元数据的文件

他是如何发现它们的？

他将 Android 手机连接到计算机，并使用 Claude Code 来调查隐藏目录。

这一发现引发了关于面部识别系统如何处理和存储生物识别数据的严重问题。

⚠️重要提示：隐藏图像文件并不自动意味着有人在监视您。有些可能是临时面部识别数据、诊断文件或缓存图像。这一说法也尚未得到独立证实。

尽管如此，还是提醒您检查您的相机权限、隐私设置和设备存储。

人工智能不再只是帮助我们建造东西。

它帮助我们调查我们的设备可能隐藏了什么。

看到这个之后你会相信你手机的面部识别吗？ 👀

保存这篇文章以供下次 Android 隐私检查时使用。

viral_posts.title_en:
Replit was building toward the AI coding era years before it had a name. In 2024, the company shipped an agent that could take a request in plain English, work through errors, provision its own infrastructure, and keep going until the software actually worked. The model companies even reached out to ask how Replit had pulled it off.

Co-founder and CEO Amjad Masad had been thinking about making programming radically more accessible since 2008, and Replit’s original pitch deck predicted AI-generated code before the Transformer paper was published. Today, that same technology is moving into banks, manufacturers, and other large companies, where Amjad says teams are replacing software projects once scoped at $10 million with $250,000 of Replit.

On How to Build the Future, @paulg sits down with @amasad to talk about why @Replit was so well positioned when coding agents arrived, what comes after vibe coding, and his bigger vision for the “self-driving company,” where AI agents increasingly build and operate the software a company needs.

viral_posts.full_text_zh:
Replit 在有名字之前几年就已经开始迈向人工智能编码时代了。 2024 年，该公司推出了一个代理，可以用简单的英语接受请求，解决错误，配置自己的基础设施，并继续运行直到软件真正运行。模型公司甚至主动询问 Replit 是如何做到这一点的。

自 2008 年以来，联合创始人兼首席执行官 Amjad Masad 一直在考虑让编程变得更加容易访问，而 Replit 最初的宣传材料在 Transformer 论文发表之前就预测了人工智能生成的代码。如今，同样的技术正在进入银行、制造商和其他大公司，Amjad 表示，这些公司的团队正在用价值 25 万美元的 Replit 取代曾经规模达 1000 万美元的软件项目。

在《如何构建未来》中，@paulg 与 @amasad 坐下来讨论了为什么 @Replit 在编码代理到来时处于如此有利的位置，vibe 编码之后会发生什么，以及他对“自动驾驶公司”的更大愿景，其中人工智能代理越来越多地构建和运营公司所需的软件。
